items.title: M&E data quality checklist
items.blurb: Completeness, timeliness, accuracy, consistency, duplicates and privacy, on one sheet you run before every report.

items.title: Indicator reference sheet
items.blurb: Define each indicator once: numerator, denominator, source, frequency and limits. Includes a worked example and a blank sheet.

items.title: Monthly programme report
items.blurb: A two-page structure for monthly reports: highlights, indicator table, challenges, actions and data quality notes.

items.title: XLSForm cheat sheet
items.blurb: Question types, required, relevant, constraint and calculation syntax with copy-ready examples and common mistakes.

items.title: Dashboard design checklist
items.blurb: Audience, layout, charts, numbers and trust: a one-page review to run before you share any Power BI or Excel dashboard.

items.title: Backup and security checklist
items.blurb: The 3-2-1 backup rule, passwords, updates, antivirus and safe sharing for small offices, clinics and NGOs.

items.title: Field data collection supervision checklist
items.blurb: What a supervisor checks during a field visit: devices, consent, form use, GPS, sync and data quality spot checks.

items.title: New staff IT setup checklist
items.blurb: Accounts, device setup, security and training for a new colleague, plus the matching exit checklist.

items.title: Logframe template
items.blurb: Goal, outcome, outputs and activities with indicators, means of verification and assumptions. Includes a guide, a worked example and a blank frame.

items.title: Training session plan
items.blurb: Objectives, a timed agenda, a materials checklist and an after-session review for data, ICT and Survey123 trainings.

items.title: Stock tracker
items.blurb: Opening stock, received, issued and losses give closing stock, months of stock and an automatic REORDER or OVERSTOCK flag.

items.title: Indicator tracker
items.blurb: Baseline, annual target and quarterly results for count indicators, with year-to-date, percent of target and a traffic-light status.

items.title: Data cleaning log
items.blurb: Record every issue found and every correction made, with drop-down issue types and an automatic summary by type and status.

items.title: IT asset register
items.blurb: Every computer, phone, printer and router in one list, with warranty status and next service date worked out for you.

items.title: Sample EPI XLSForm
items.blurb: A short monthly facility form with validation, skip logic and a calculated field. Upload to Survey123 Connect or KoboToolbox and adapt.

items.title: Reporting timeliness tracker
items.blurb: Log the date each facility report arrives. Every month turns On time, Late or Missing, with completeness and timeliness rates and a chart.

items.title: Training attendance and results tracker
items.blurb: Attendance for up to five days, pre and post test scores, improvement and certificate eligibility, with a summary and a chart.
